title: Chimney Park Revitalization
description: In partnership with the City of Pensacola and HALFF Associates, Bluffline is revitalizing Chimney Park — improving landscaping, access, and public amenities to create a welcoming greenspace along the corridor for Pensacola residents.
featuredImageAlt: View of Chimney Park from the railroad tracks
